# BookerBob: Proof of Loyalty

> Google for agentic commerce. Proof of loyalty, everywhere you go. Customers prove they were customers of a place without revealing who they are; in return they get honest reviews and returning-customer discounts, and BookerBob, their agent, ranks and books places using only reviews nobody can buy. Built at HackMeridian 2026 (Stellar), Genesis path, track Stellar Unlocked. Stellar testnet.

## Problem
- Reviews on travel and commerce platforms are inflated; neither a customer nor the customer's agent can tell a real review from a bought one.
- Returning-customer discounts cost personal data and history. The customer pays for the discount with their data.

## The ZK primitive and its uses
One Semaphore v4 Groth16 proof (BN254), made in the browser: "I hold one of the leaves in this place's customer tree", without saying which. Only the nullifier scope changes:
- anonymous review: one review per stay, author unknown
- returning-customer discount: once per past stay per season, USDC paid in the same transaction
- context perks: network and attested groups (REP verified traveler), stacked and capped, one transaction
- dispute disclosure: the author privately proves a review is theirs to an arbiter
- agentic checkout over UCP: a buyer's agent claims the discount at a Shopify test store and pays in test USDC on Stellar

## Stellar host functions used
- BN254 g1_add, g1_mul, pairing_check (Groth16 verifier): https://github.com/hustle1hustle/bookerbob-hackmeridian-2026/blob/main/contracts/proof_of_stay/src/verifier.rs
- Poseidon (soroban-poseidon, circomlib parameters), on-chain LeanIMT customer trees: https://github.com/hustle1hustle/bookerbob-hackmeridian-2026/blob/main/contracts/proof_of_stay/src/tree.rs
- secp256r1_verify (REP tier credential, P-256): https://github.com/hustle1hustle/bookerbob-hackmeridian-2026/blob/main/contracts/proof_of_stay/src/tier.rs
- keccak256 (Semaphore message and scope hashing) and USDC via the Stellar Asset Contract: https://github.com/hustle1hustle/bookerbob-hackmeridian-2026/blob/main/contracts/proof_of_stay/src/lib.rs
- fee-bump transactions sponsor a fresh payer per booking: https://github.com/hustle1hustle/bookerbob-hackmeridian-2026/blob/main/server/src/payer.ts

## Honest limitations
- Testnet only. The verifier follows the official soroban-examples structure, which is unaudited.
- Demo places are checked in by the BookerBob backend, and the arbiter is our backend; production needs places signing their own checkouts and a blind arbiter (TEE or MPC).
- Anonymity set = that place's checked-in customers (public leaf list, max 1024); small places give a small set.
- The REP tier issuer is still trusted to sign the credential the contract checks with P-256; for live rehearsals the operator can fall back to add_member when the issuer refuses.
- One admin key controls upgrade, groups, the season clock and issuer keys; production moves these to a multisig with a timelock.
- One-time payers are funded by a test-USDC faucet; production needs a private balance so the payer is not linked to the guest.
